load_checkpoint_from_path: load a PyTorch checkpoint from a list of candidate paths using iopath file manager
filter_state_dict_with_unix_patterns: filter a model state dict to include only parameters matching unix glob patterns
exclude_state_dict_with_unix_patterns: exclude parameters from a model state dict that match unix glob patterns
load_state_dict_into_model: load a state dict into a PyTorch model with optional kernel transforms and key ignore patterns
assert_skipped_parameters_are_frozen: assert that model parameters matching given patterns are frozen and not trainable
